questions.question: Which is the kindest, most useful review comment?
options: "What happens here if the list is empty?"
"I would never write it like this."
questions.explanation: Questions about the code (not the person) help the author think and learn.

questions.question: Why keep pull requests small?
options: They get reviewed faster and more carefully
questions.explanation: Big PRs get skimmed. Small, focused ones get real attention.
